tooltip.the_long_travail.maid_compat.bas: Functions as a maid accessory only when equipped in the maid's native bauble slots.
tooltip.the_long_travail.maid_compat.dia: Malice and Witness effects apply according to the state of the Long Travail equipped by her owner
tooltip.the_long_travail.maid_compat.tok: Maids cannot use accessory abilities that require player activation
jei.the_long_travail.flowers:
A Corner of Spring holds up to three flowers, with no duplicate flower types.
Crafting it with a water bucket washes away secondary flowers and returns an empty bucket, but does not reset the primary flower.
If no primary flower has been selected, craft the accessory with one flower to make that flower its permanent primary flower.
jei.the_long_travail.limits: Up to three flowers, with no duplicate flower types
jei.the_long_travail.block_drop.descript: Breaking Budding Amethyst as a player has a 0.5% chance to drop 1 essence; Silk Touch and Fortune do not affect the chance or amount.
jei.the_long_travail.block_drop.prince_p: Players have a %s%% chance to obtain one Little Prince when breaking a poppy. Does not trigger in Creative mode.
jei.the_long_travail.block_drop.prince_r: Players have a %s%% chance to obtain one Little Prince when breaking a rose bush. Rolls once per plant. Does not trigger in Creative mode.
tooltip.the_long_travail.jade.pick_up_fo: Pick up this item to view its full description in your inventory.
tooltip.the_long_travail.maid_compat.laf: Functions as a maid accessory only when equipped in the maid's native bauble slots.
Malice and Witness effects follow the state of The Long Travail worn by the owner
jei.the_long_travail.perfect_fluid.title: Perfect Fluid Duplication (Examples)
jei.the_long_travail.perfect_fluid.stack: Example: consume one Perfect Fluid and one diamond to obtain two diamonds. Perfect Fluid itself, The Long Travail, and blacklisted items cannot be copied. Perfect Fluid and The Long Travail are removed from copied containers and their nested containers.
jei.the_long_travail.perfect_fluid.unsta: Example: consume one Perfect Fluid to obtain a copy of a sword. The far-right sword is the original left in the crafting grid. Removing Perfect Fluid from the copy does not affect the original container contents.
tooltip.the_long_travail.maid_compat.rel: Functions as a maid accessory only when equipped in the maid's native bauble slots
tooltip.the_long_travail.maid_compat.ban: Souls from creatures killed by a maid are added only to the banner she wears
If the owner is not wearing The Long Travail, the banner worn by the maid stops accumulating souls and granting attributes
